mapper.select:
select SEQUENCE_NO id, AGENCY_NAME text from DIS_SALE_AGENCY
and (SEQUENCE_NO like concat(concat('%',#{search}),'%') or AGENCY_NAME like concat(concat('%',#{search}),'%'))

select distinct PROD_SERIES id, PROD_SERIES text from REP_PROD_INFO where (P_PROD_ID is null or PROD_ID=P_PROD_ID) and status='E' and PROD_SERIES is not null
and PROD_SERIES like concat(concat('%',#{search}),'%')
select count(1) count from REP_PROD_INFO where P_PROD_ID is null and PROD_ID=#{prodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
select AGENCY_ID agencyId, PROD_ID prodId from DIS_PROD_AGENCY where AGENCY_ID=#{sequenceNo,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

select PROD_ID id, PROD_NAME name, case PD_STATUS when '01' then (case ISSUING_WAY when '01' then '0101' || PROD_SERIES when '02' then '0102' || PROD_SERIES else '' end ) when '02' then (case ISSUING_WAY when '01' then '0201' || PROD_SERIES when '02' then '0202' || PROD_SERIES else '' end ) when '03' then (case ISSUING_WAY when '01' then '0301' || PROD_SERIES when '02' then '0301' || PROD_SERIES else '' end ) else '' end pid from REP_PROD_INFO where (P_PROD_ID is null or PROD_ID=P_PROD_ID) and status='E'
